meaning.en: To build up or run something with great care and effort.
meaning.zh: 费尽心思地经营、筹划。

equivalents: put one's heart and soul into

examples.zh: 这家小店是他苦心经营了二十年的心血。
examples.en: This little shop is the fruit of twenty years of his painstaking work.

examples.zh: 她苦心经营的形象一夜之间就毁了。
examples.en: The image she had so carefully cultivated was ruined overnight.

examples.zh: 球队经过多年苦心经营，终于打进了决赛。
examples.en: After years of patient building, the team finally reached the final.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; often 苦心经营的 + noun.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，常说“苦心经营的……”。

meaning.en: To see something only vaguely, without a clear understanding.
meaning.zh: 在雾中看花，比喻看事物模模糊糊，看不真切。

examples.zh: 对这场改革，很多人还是雾里看花。
examples.en: Many people still have only a hazy idea of what this reform means.

examples.zh: 只看新闻标题，就像雾里看花。
examples.en: Reading only the headlines is like looking at things through fog.

examples.zh: 他对父母的婚姻一直是雾里看花，看不明白。
examples.en: He never really understood his parents' marriage; it was all a blur to him.

usage.en: Predicate; often 如同/像雾里看花.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“像雾里看花”。

story.en: In his late poem written on a boat at the Cold Food Festival, Du Fu, aged and ill, writes that he sees the flowers "as if through mist" (老年花似雾中看). The image of misty flowers became 雾里看花.
story.zh: 杜甫晚年在舟中过寒食节，作《小寒食舟中作》，写道“老年花似雾中看”，感叹老眼昏花。此意象演变为“雾里看花”。

meaning.en: Having had formal professional training, originally in a traditional opera school.
meaning.zh: 原指出身于旧时培养戏曲演员的科班，今泛指受过正规专业训练。

examples.zh: 她是科班出身的演员，基本功很扎实。
examples.en: She's a classically trained actress with solid fundamentals.

examples.zh: 他不是科班出身，编程全靠自学。
examples.en: He has no formal training; he taught himself to code.

examples.zh: 这家报社的记者大多是新闻科班出身。
examples.en: Most of this paper's reporters studied journalism formally.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; 不是科班出身 = self-taught.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语；“不是科班出身”指非正规训练出来的。

meaning.en: To argue forcefully and confidently, often in defence of something unreasonable.
meaning.zh: 形容自以为理由充分，说个不停（多含贬义）。

examples.zh: 明明是他错了，他还说得振振有词。
examples.en: He was clearly in the wrong, yet he argued as if he were completely right.

examples.zh: 孩子振振有词地解释为什么没写作业。
examples.en: The child confidently explained why he hadn't done his homework.

examples.zh: 面对记者，发言人振振有词。
examples.en: Facing the reporters, the spokesman was full of self-assured answers.

usage.en: Adverbial or predicate; usually implies the argument is weak.
usage.zh: 多作状语、谓语，多含贬义。也作“振振有辞”。

meaning.en: To speak while weeping, in great grief or emotion.
meaning.zh: 一边说一边哭，形容极其悲痛或激动。

examples.zh: 她声泪俱下地讲述了自己的遭遇。
examples.en: Through her tears, she told of what had happened to her.

examples.zh: 受害者家属在法庭上声泪俱下。
examples.en: The victim's family wept as they spoke in court.

examples.zh: 老人声泪俱下，请求大家帮忙找孩子。
examples.en: In tears, the old man begged everyone to help find the child.

usage.zh: 多作状语、谓语。

meaning.en: One's best, signature skill.
meaning.zh: 指自己最拿手、最擅长的本领。

examples.zh: 红烧肉是我妈的看家本领。
examples.en: Braised pork belly is my mum's signature dish.

examples.zh: 这场比赛他拿出了看家本领。
examples.en: In this match he pulled out his trademark moves.

examples.zh: 服务好是这家酒店的看家本领。
examples.en: Great service is this hotel's real strength.

usage.en: Object; often 拿出/使出看家本领.
usage.zh: 多作宾语，常说“拿出看家本领”。

meaning.en: To leave without saying goodbye.
meaning.zh: 没有告辞就离开了。

examples.zh: 他昨晚不辞而别，谁也不知道去了哪儿。
examples.en: He left last night without a word, and no one knows where he went.

examples.zh: 新来的员工干了三天就不辞而别了。
examples.en: The new hire disappeared after three days without telling anyone.

examples.zh: 她的不辞而别让我很伤心。
examples.en: Her leaving without saying goodbye really hurt me.

usage.en: Predicate; also as a noun phrase 他的不辞而别.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，也可作主语、宾语。

meaning.en: To do a job perfunctorily, just enough to get by.
meaning.zh: 做事不认真负责，只是应付了事。

examples.zh: 对群众的投诉，绝不能敷衍塞责。
examples.en: Complaints from the public must never be brushed off.

examples.zh: 这份报告明显是敷衍塞责之作。
examples.en: This report is obviously a half-hearted effort.

examples.zh: 他工作敷衍塞责，被领导批评了。
examples.en: He was criticised by his boss for just going through the motions.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; formal, often in criticism.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，书面语，多用于批评。

meaning.en: To never recover after a single setback.
meaning.zh: 一跌倒就再也爬不起来，比喻遭受挫折后不能再振作。

examples.zh: 高考失利后，他一蹶不振。
examples.en: After failing the college entrance exam, he never got back on his feet.

examples.zh: 那家公司经历丑闻后一蹶不振。
examples.en: The company never recovered from the scandal.

examples.zh: 输一场球不算什么，千万不能一蹶不振。
examples.en: Losing one game is nothing — just don't let it knock you down for good.

usage.zh: 多作谓语。

antonyms: 留得青山在，不怕没柴烧
野火烧不尽，春风吹又生
胜败兵家事不期，包羞忍耻是男儿
江东子弟多才俊，卷土重来未可知
千锤万凿出深山，烈火焚烧若等闲
雄关漫道真如铁，而今迈步从头越
千磨万击还坚劲，任尔东西南北风

meaning.en: To let something take its own course without any guidance or control.
meaning.zh: 听任其自由发展，不加管理和引导。

examples.zh: 对孩子不能放任自流。
examples.en: You can't just leave children to their own devices.

examples.zh: 管理层对这些问题放任自流，结果越来越严重。
examples.en: Management let the problems drift and they only got worse.

examples.zh: 市场需要监管，不能放任自流。
examples.en: Markets need regulation; they can't simply be left to themselves.

usage.zh: 多作谓语。

meaning.en: To not mention something at all.
meaning.zh: 一个字也不提起。

examples.zh: 对于自己的病，他在家人面前只字不提。
examples.en: He never said a word about his illness to his family.

examples.zh: 声明对赔偿问题只字不提。
examples.en: The statement made no mention whatsoever of compensation.

examples.zh: 她对前男友的事只字不提。
examples.en: She won't say a single word about her ex-boyfriend.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“对……只字不提”。

meaning.en: To hide here and there to avoid being caught.
meaning.zh: 到处躲藏。

examples.zh: 逃犯东躲西藏了三年，最终落网。
examples.en: The fugitive was on the run for three years before he was caught.

examples.zh: 为了躲债，他整天东躲西藏。
examples.en: To dodge his creditors, he's always hiding somewhere.

examples.zh: 战争年代，一家人东躲西藏。
examples.en: During the war, the family moved from one hiding place to another.

usage.zh: 多作谓语。

meaning.en: The Great Wall of China; figuratively, a nation's mainstay or bulwark.
meaning.zh: 指中国的长城，也比喻国家所倚重的人或力量。

examples.zh: 我们去爬了万里长城。
examples.en: We went to climb the Great Wall.

examples.zh: 人民军队被称为祖国的万里长城。
examples.en: The army is called the Great Wall of the motherland.

examples.zh: 万里长城不是一天建成的。
examples.en: The Great Wall wasn't built in a day.

story.en: When the general Tan Daoji was arrested, he flung down his cap and cried, 'You are destroying your own Great Wall!' (乃坏汝万里长城).
story.zh: 南朝宋名将檀道济被捕时，脱帻投地说：“乃坏汝万里长城！”

usage.zh: 作名词；比喻义多见于书面语。

pinyin: chāi dōng qiáng bǔ xī qiáng
literal: pull-down · east · wall · patch · west · wall

meaning.en: To solve one problem by creating another; to cover one debt with another.
meaning.zh: 比喻临时勉强应付，顾此失彼，问题并没有真正解决。

examples.zh: 他用这张信用卡还那张，完全是拆东墙补西墙。
examples.en: Paying one credit card with another is just robbing Peter to pay Paul.

examples.zh: 学校把体育课改成数学课，是拆东墙补西墙。
examples.en: Turning PE lessons into maths lessons only shifts the problem elsewhere.

examples.zh: 靠借新债还旧债，拆东墙补西墙，终究不是办法。
examples.en: Borrowing new money to repay old debts is no long-term solution.

usage.en: Predicate or object; often 是拆东墙补西墙.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、宾语。

natural: with a great show of seriousness

meaning.en: Acting as if something were real or important when it is not.
meaning.zh: 装模作样，好像真有这么回事似的。

equivalents: with a great show of seriousness

examples.zh: 他煞有介事地说自己见过外星人。
examples.en: He solemnly claimed he had seen aliens.

examples.zh: 几个孩子煞有介事地开起了会。
examples.en: The children held a meeting with great seriousness.

examples.zh: 那篇报道写得煞有介事，其实全是谣言。
examples.en: The article sounded very convincing, but it was all rumour.

usage.zh: 多作状语，常说“煞有介事地……”。也作“像煞有介事”。

meaning.en: (Of tears) to suddenly well up and stream out.
meaning.zh: 眼泪一下子从眼眶里涌出来。

examples.zh: 听到这个消息，她的眼泪夺眶而出。
examples.en: When she heard the news, tears streamed from her eyes.

examples.zh: 站上领奖台的那一刻，他的泪水夺眶而出。
examples.en: The moment he stood on the podium, his tears came flooding out.

examples.zh: 看到久别的母亲，我的眼泪夺眶而出。
examples.en: Seeing my mother after so long, I burst into tears.

usage.en: Predicate; subject is 眼泪/泪水.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，主语多为“眼泪、泪水”。

meaning.en: To settle a matter with one decisive word or act.
meaning.zh: 原指制锣时最后一锤决定音色，比喻凭一句话作出决定。

examples.zh: 大家争论不休，最后老板一锤定音。
examples.en: Everyone kept arguing until the boss made the final call.

examples.zh: 这粒点球一锤定音，主队获胜。
examples.en: The penalty settled it, and the home side won.

examples.zh: 这件事要等董事会一锤定音。
examples.en: This will have to wait for the board's final decision.

usage.zh: 多作谓语。

meaning.en: To act too hastily in handling something.
meaning.zh: 处理事情过于急躁。

examples.zh: 改革要循序渐进，不能操之过急。
examples.en: Reform should be gradual; you can't rush it.

examples.zh: 教育孩子不能操之过急。
examples.en: You can't be impatient when bringing up children.

examples.zh: 这件事你有点操之过急了。
examples.en: You were a bit too hasty over this.

usage.en: Predicate; usually negative: 不能/不宜操之过急.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“不能操之过急”。

natural: toss and turn; over and over

meaning.en: To toss and turn; or to do or say something over and over again.
meaning.zh: 来回翻身，也形容一次又一次地重复。

examples.zh: 我昨晚翻来覆去睡不着。
examples.en: I tossed and turned all night and couldn't sleep.

examples.zh: 他翻来覆去就那几句话。
examples.en: He keeps repeating the same few words.

examples.zh: 这个问题我翻来覆去想了好几天。
examples.en: I've turned this question over in my mind for days.

usage.zh: 多作状语、谓语。

meaning.en: To fall ill from long-term overwork.
meaning.zh: 因长期过度劳累而生病。

examples.zh: 他为工作日夜操劳，终于积劳成疾。
examples.en: Working day and night, he eventually fell ill from exhaustion.

examples.zh: 这位老教师积劳成疾，倒在了讲台上。
examples.en: The veteran teacher, worn out by years of work, collapsed in the classroom.

examples.zh: 别太拼了，小心积劳成疾。
examples.en: Don't push yourself so hard — you'll make yourself ill.

usage.zh: 多作谓语。

meaning.en: Sweet, flattering words, often used to deceive.
meaning.zh: 像蜜糖一样甜的话，多指为讨好或哄骗人而说的好听话。

examples.zh: 别被他的甜言蜜语骗了。
examples.en: Don't be fooled by his sweet talk.

examples.zh: 骗子用甜言蜜语骗走了老人的积蓄。
examples.en: The conman sweet-talked the old man out of his savings.

examples.zh: 情侣之间总少不了甜言蜜语。
examples.en: Couples always whisper sweet nothings to each other.

usage.zh: 多作主语、宾语。

meaning.en: Completely indifferent and unconcerned.
meaning.zh: 形容态度冷淡，毫不关心。

examples.zh: 他对别人的困难漠不关心。
examples.en: He's completely indifferent to other people's problems.

examples.zh: 年轻人不能对社会问题漠不关心。
examples.en: Young people shouldn't be indifferent to social issues.

examples.zh: 父亲对他的学习漠不关心。
examples.en: His father couldn't care less about his schoolwork.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“对……漠不关心”。

antonyms: 衙斋卧听萧萧竹，疑是民间疾苦声
位卑未敢忘忧国，事定犹须待阖棺
居庙堂之高则忧其民；处江湖之远则忧其君
风声雨声读书声，声声入耳；家事国事天下事，事事关心
长太息以掩涕兮，哀民生之多艰

meaning.en: To appeal loudly and urgently to draw attention to something.
meaning.zh: 大声呼喊，提醒人们注意。

examples.zh: 专家们大声疾呼，要求保护野生动物。
examples.en: Experts are urgently calling for wildlife protection.

examples.zh: 他多年来一直为环保大声疾呼。
examples.en: For years he has been a vocal campaigner for the environment.

examples.zh: 面对校园欺凌，我们必须大声疾呼。
examples.en: In the face of school bullying, we must speak out loudly.

origin.source: 韩愈《后十九日复上宰相书》

story.en: Han Yu, petitioning the chief minister, wrote that someone in peril would 'raise his voice and cry out urgently' for help (大其声疾呼).
story.zh: 韩愈《后十九日复上宰相书》：“……则将大其声疾呼而望其仁之也。”

usage.zh: 多作谓语，书面语。

meaning.en: Disorderly and without any system.
meaning.zh: 又多又乱，没有条理。

examples.zh: 他的房间杂乱无章。
examples.en: His room is a complete mess.

examples.zh: 这篇文章写得杂乱无章，看不出重点。
examples.en: This essay is so disorganised you can't find the main point.

examples.zh: 仓库里的货物堆放得杂乱无章。
examples.en: The goods in the warehouse were piled up any old how.

story.en: Han Yu described certain writing as 'mixed up and without order' (其为言也，杂乱而无章).
story.zh: 韩愈《送孟东野序》：“其为言也，杂乱而无章。”

usage.zh: 多作谓语、补语。

meaning.en: To rouse oneself and work hard to catch up.
meaning.zh: 振作起来，努力追赶。

examples.zh: 落后的同学正在奋起直追。
examples.en: The students who fell behind are now working hard to catch up.

examples.zh: 下半场客队奋起直追，扳平了比分。
examples.en: In the second half the visitors rallied and drew level.

examples.zh: 面对差距，我们必须奋起直追。
examples.en: Faced with this gap, we must strive to catch up.

usage.zh: 多作谓语。
